# alternative: [people] write insert raw=new: failed the phone's default account for new contacts is a cloud account, so it refuses one saved to the phone
why no row can produce it on a device: said only on a phone whose default account for new contacts is a cloud one (Android 16's rule); the AVD has no such default, and one cannot be set from adb without an account's authenticator on the image
the JVM test that covers it: PeopleWriterTest (app/src/test/kotlin/app/tileshell/people/PeopleWriterTest.kt) — aPhoneWhoseDefaultAccountIsACloudOneRefusesASaveToThePhoneBeforeAnythingIsWritten (asserts the result and that nothing was written; the line's text is not asserted)
